text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Kh! It won't open?!
Golshi-san, open this door immediately!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Do you hear me?! Golshi-san!!
Golshi-saaaan?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Kh... Pulling pranks without learning a thing.
And here I thought it was unusual for her not
to skip cleanup duty today...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Orfe-san, where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
We shall sleep.
Resolve this before We awaken.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! Classmates are supposed to cooperate
in emergencies and look for a way out together!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Besides, that mat has not been cleared for
safety! Please wait...!
*PFFFFFFFFT—!!*

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A whoopee cushion!
That was a close call!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Knowing Golshi-san,
she must have set up plenty more traps
all over the storage shed—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Let us eliminate all hazardous materials together
and safely escape this PE shed!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
*Cough*! *Cough*!
Smoke came out of the ball...!!
Orfe-san, are you alright?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
There's something under this traffic cone—
This is... birdlime glue!
Stay back!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... My hands are completely red.
To think paint was coated on the furlong pole—
Good thing I found it before Orfe-san touched it...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
*Pant*, *pant*, *pant*...
T-That should take care of every single threat.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
To plead for the King's aid,
yet handle it all by yourself—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I-Indeed...!!
My body simply moved on its own out of the urge
to keep a citizen out of harm's way—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: However... well, that is fine.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Responding to situations with utmost devotion to protect
citizen safety is a duty this officer has pledged upon herself.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
As a citizen who deserves protection, I shielded you
with my own body. This officer takes great pride in that, sir!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
—...
Comparing the King to commoners is utter insolence.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Yet, such earnest simplicity—pleases Us. Keep at it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Sir!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Orfe!
Are you alright? Meno-san too—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much for your assistance
and for providing eyewitness testimony on the culprit!
This officer shall proceed to apprehend her immediately!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—With that said,
I shall carry out my mission!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... I was worried you had spent your time in vain,
but... it seems my concerns were unfounded.

I caught sight of Fenomeno cornering
Gold Ship at the central plaza.
She looked livelier than usual.
